name: @weavetab/plugin-github
description: Official Weavetab GitHub plugin — modular repository analysis, raw source reads, issues, pull requests, raw diffs, CLI commands, and active-tab DOM inspection without burning browser turns or API quota.

config.reason: Read and persist isolated plugin settings.

cdp.reason: Reads URL and DOM on github.com without navigating or mutating.

network.reason: Fetches repository metadata, issues, PRs, raw files, and diffs from GitHub.

tools.reason: Registers the 6 modular github_* MCP tools.

commands.reason: Registers repo-summary and pr-diff CLI commands.

tools.name: github_analyze
tools.description: High-level repository reconnaissance: metadata, default branch, recursive file tree, and README preview. Results are cached in isolated storage.

repo.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format or GitHub URL (inferred from active tab if omitted).

tools.name: github_read
tools.description: Fetch raw file contents from raw.githubusercontent.com with zero REST API quota consumption.

repo.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format or GitHub URL.

paths.description: File paths relative to repository root.

branch.description: Target branch or tag (defaults to cached default branch or 'main').

tools.name: github_issues
tools.description: Inspect a single issue with comments or list/search repository issues.

repo.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format or GitHub URL.

number.description: Specific issue number to fetch with timeline comments.

search.description: Search query string for repository issues.

tools.name: github_pull_request
tools.description: Inspect a pull request (changed files, diff stats, comments) or list recent pull requests.

repo.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format or GitHub URL.

limit.description: Max PRs to return when listing (default 10).

tools.name: github_diff
tools.description: Fetch raw unified diffs or git patches directly from github.com with zero REST API quota usage.

repo.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format or GitHub URL.

pull_number.description: Pull request number to fetch diff for.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA to fetch diff for.

base.description: Base branch or commit for compare diff.

head.description: Head branch or commit for compare diff.

tools.name: github_active_tab
tools.description: Extract structured repository, PR, issue, or blob state from the active github.com browser tab via local CDP.

commands.name: repo-summary
commands.description: Fetch repository metadata, default branch, file tree, and README snippet via CLI.

options.name: repo
options.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format or full GitHub URL

commands.name: pr-diff
commands.description: Fetch unified diff and stats for a pull request directly from GitHub without API quota.

commands.name: issue-search
commands.description: Search open or closed repository issues by keyword directly via CLI.

prompts.name: pr-review
prompts.description: Structured pull request review prompt for security, performance, and regression analysis.

prompts.name: issue-triage
prompts.description: Structured issue triage prompt to diagnose root cause and plan implementation.

resources.name: github-ratelimit
resources.description: Current GitHub REST API rate-limit budget and quota status.

resources.name: github-context
resources.description: Active tab GitHub DOM context (current repository, branch, open PR, or issue metadata).
